enemies.name: Atom-Eater
enemies.notes: Porcelain crabs that eat loose Crono atoms. Break: drops a Time Atom (+0.5 Crono integrity). The teaching enemy for the repair loop. Summoned by Lavic Filament Guardians each time their shield finishes rebuilding.

enemies.name: Bekkler Doll Failed (Type-C)
enemies.notes: Galaxy reveal always on. Hums the cracked Time Egg note (220 Hz). Within 5 m of Crono, Crono hears his own heartbeat doubled: a cue that his ASTRAL cost is running. Rubber-hose walk on twos plus clay steps. Break: frown mask; drops a Gold Leaf flake.

enemies.name: Lavic Filament Guardian
enemies.notes: The Heart's antibody. [CIRCLE] is a shape weakness (matched by CIRCLE-shaped actions, not tags). Anchored by a filament that only a LINE_PIERCE can sever; while anchored, it summons an Atom-Eater every time its shield finishes rebuilding (the summon should be tied to break_recovered while anchored, not to turns). Its Break is a deliberate gift: the frozen body is a ShapeCast reposition platform.

enemies.name: Paradox Curator Choir
enemies.notes: A remnant of R-66Y: the rotating ring at 0.5x speed (hence the long telegraph). Break: the masks weep blue and black oil at once. Drops the Gramophone Resonance record 'Crono-Original lullaby to Sera in vitro'.
